id.description: Stable key, e.g. 'Gent1' or 'MerelbekeMelle'. The justice of the peace of a canton has the id 'Vredegerecht' + canton id.

name.description: Name of the canton; usually the seat, but not always ('Oudergem' sits in Etterbeek)

number.description: Canton number for places with several cantons (Gent 1–5, …)

seat.description: Where the justice of the peace sits

municipalities.description: The municipalities the canton covers. `partial` marks a municipality that is split over several cantons; `territory` then says which part belongs to this one.

territory.description: The canton's area, verbatim from the annex to the Judicial Code

source.description: Where in the annex to the Judicial Code the canton is defined

Canton.description: A judicial canton: the area of one justice of the peace

Bilingual.description: A name as the Judicial Code gives it, in Dutch and French
